qc.heading: Five-layer inspection process for premium product quality

steps.title: Incoming Material Check
steps.text: Movements, cases, straps and packaging verified against standards on arrival.

steps.title: Tensile Test
steps.text: Strap, lug and case-back strength tested to secure daily-wear durability.

steps.title: Waterproof Test
steps.text: Pressure testing for every rated water-resistance level before assembly sign-off.

steps.title: Timing Accuracy Test
steps.text: Each movement calibrated and measured for stable, certified timekeeping.

steps.title: Finished Goods Sampling
steps.text: Batch sampling inspection before packing — nothing ships unverified.

process.heading: Full-cycle brand customization, from sketch to shelf

steps.title: Demand Communication
steps.text: One-on-one consultation on brand positioning, watch styles, movements, materials, MOQs and delivery schedules.

steps.title: Design Finalization
steps.text: Complete structural design drawings delivered, revised as requested, locked upon mutual confirmation.

steps.title: Sample Validation
steps.text: Physical prototypes produced and fully standard-tested to set mass-production benchmarks.

steps.title: Mass Production
steps.text: Full assembly-line manufacturing with in-process quality inspection — stable quality, punctual delivery.
